<html:body xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul">
<dialog id="virtualFolderPropertiesDialog"
        buttons="accept,cancel"
        style="min-width: 60em; min-height: 30em;">

  <html:div class="grid-two-column-fr grid-items-center">
    <label
      id="nameLabel"
      data-l10n-id="virtual-folder-name"
      control="name"
    />
    <hbox class="input-container">
      <html:input id="name"
                  hidden="hidden"
                  class="input-inline"
                  aria-labelledby="nameLabel"
                  oninput="doEnabling();"/>
      <html:input id="existingName"
                  readonly="readonly"
                  hidden="hidden"
                  class="input-inline"
                  tabindex="0"/>
      <hbox id="iconColorContainer" align="center" collapsed="collapsed">
        <label
          id="colorLabel"
          data-l10n-id="folder-props-color"
          control="color"
        />
        <html:input id="color"
                    type="color"
                    value=""
                    class="input-inline-color"
